qa_pairs.question: From 2021 to 2023, did the change trends of the online food delivery user scale in China and the national catering revenue match? Answer yes or no.
qa_pairs.explanation: The two time series rose synchronously in 2021 (the number of users increased from 418.83 million to 544.16 million, and the catering revenue increased from 3.95 trillion yuan to 4.69 trillion yuan), declined synchronously in 2022, and rebounded synchronously in 2023, showing a consistent 'rise - fall - rise' trend.

qa_pairs.question: From 2018 to 2023, was there a positive correlation between the year - on - year growth rate of the national catering revenue and the year - on - year growth rate of the online food delivery market size? Answer positive correlation, negative correlation, or no correlation.
qa_pairs.explanation: The growth rate of catering revenue was negative in 2020 and 2022, while the online food delivery market still maintained positive growth. They only rose in the same direction in 2021 and 2023, and the directions were opposite in the remaining years. Overall, the correlation was not obvious.

qa_pairs.question: As of 2023, was the year with the highest online food delivery user scale in the country also the year with the highest online food delivery market size and the highest national catering revenue? Answer yes or no.
qa_pairs.explanation: Although the online food delivery user scale and the catering revenue both reached stage highs in 2023 (5.29 trillion yuan), the predicted values of the online food delivery market size from 2024 to 2027 were higher (the highest was 1956.7 billion yuan). Therefore, 2023 was not the year when all three indicators reached their extreme values.

qa_pairs.question: What is the proportion of the online food delivery market size in 2023 to the total catering revenue in China in 2023? Express the answer as a percentage and round to 2 decimal places. Answer: xx.xx%
qa_pairs.explanation: Online food delivery market size in 2023 (1525.4 billion yuan) ÷ Total catering revenue in 2023 (5290 billion yuan) = 0.288355. Rounding to 2 decimal places gives 28.84%.

qa_pairs.question: What is the approximate per - capita annual catering expenditure in 2023? Round to the nearest integer. Answer: xx yuan
qa_pairs.explanation: Total catering revenue in 2023 (5290 billion yuan) = 5.29×10^12 yuan; Number of food delivery users in 2023 (544.54 million people) = 5.4454×10^8 people; Per - capita expenditure = 5.29×10^12 yuan ÷ 5.4454×10^8 people ≈ 9715 yuan.

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference between the overall food delivery penetration rate and the online food delivery industry penetration rate in 2023? Express the answer as a percentage and round to 2 decimal places. Answer: xx.xx%
qa_pairs.explanation: Overall food delivery penetration rate (49.9%) - Online food delivery industry penetration rate (28.8%) = 21.10%.
